title: Gaban
desc: An unemployed son of an honest clerk tries to use his charm to con his way to a better life.

title: Ittefaq
desc: Dilip Roy is a painter by trade and, despite possessing a beautiful wife called Sushma, he spends most of his time painting. On the day of their anniversary celebration, Dilip is late finishing a painting when a frustrated Sushma snatches the brush from his hand. Furious, Dilip strangles her to death, is arrested and sent to a psychiatric institute.

title: Do Waqt Ki Roti
desc: When a notorious criminal breaks out of prison, Jailer Vijay resigns and vows to arrest him. However, Shankar, a brother set on avenging his sister's death, stands in Vijay's way.

title: Param Dharam
desc: Savitri believes that her illegitimate child with her deceased lover, Vijay, was stillborn and did not survive. Years later, Savitri's world changes when she learns that her firstborn is alive.
